headline: OpenAI reportedly raises $11 billion at $1.25 trillion valuation
summary: OpenAI reportedly raised an additional $11 billion in a new funding round pegging it at a $1.25 trillion valuation, following its $122 billion raise in March at an $852 billion valuation. Outlets differ on whether the round has already closed, as rival Anthropic nears its own IPO.

claims.statement: OpenAI reportedly raised an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation.

sources.quote: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO

claims.statement: OpenAI previously raised $122 billion in March at an $852 billion valuation.

discrepancies.explanation: Outlets differ on whether the new valuation is already in effect or still pending: one says the round hasn't closed yet, the other describes OpenAI as already valued there.
